timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the vastness of space, there exists a planet where it rains glass sideways.
Welcome to the extraordinary world of HD 189733B, a scorching hot exoplanet located 63 light
years away from Earth. This bizarre planet experiences glass showers due to its wild atmospheric
conditions, where winds reach supersonic speeds of over 5,400 miles per hour, 8,700 kilometers per
hour. These hurricane-like winds carry tiny particles of silicate glass, causing them to condense
and fall as rain in sideways sheets. It's a cosmic weather phenomenon like no other,
making HD 189733B a true wonder of the universe.
